Name: Noche's Crystal Path Recolor
Author: luxidoptera
Description:
It's always bothered me that the Crystal Path, while a fine-looking path on its own, doesn't even attempt to match the color palette of the item it's made from, Refined Quartz. It doesn't even look like the same material. This mod fixes that.

This mod recolors the Crystal Path to one of two different color palettes (standard and winter variant), with the main color being Refined Quartz purple. All colors used in each palette come from minerals in the game- the standard palette uses Star Shards and Fire Quartz, while the winter palette uses Celestine and Frozen Tear.
